messages.body: Hi, what is the starting price for 4 BHK Sky Villa in Grand Horizon?

Namaste Vikramaditya ji. The Grand Horizon Sky Villas (Sector 65, Golf Course Ext Road) start at ₹8.50 Cr for 4,250 sq.ft duplex configurations, featuring private high-speed elevators, double-height living ceilings, and panoramic golf course vistas (RERA Approved: RC/REP/HARERA/GGM/2023/88). Would you like to schedule a private site tour this weekend?
Yes, can I book a site visit for this Sunday at 11 AM with chauffeur pickup?

Your VIP Private Site Tour has been reserved for Sunday at 11:00 AM. Raghav Singhal (Managing Director) will personally host you at the Horizon Experience Lounge. Gate Pass Code: #VIP-7701. Chauffeur pickup is scheduled 45 minutes prior. We look forward to welcoming you.
I want to discuss customized 20:80 construction-linked payment plans with your sales director directly.

Understood, Ms. Oberoi. I have flagged your request with priority to our Managing Director, Mr. Raghav Singhal. He will contact you directly on this number within 15 minutes to review bespoke payment structures.
What is the price, RERA number, and carpet area for 4 BHK Sky Villa in Grand Horizon?

The Grand Horizon Penthouse & Sky Villas (Golf Course Extension Road, Sector 65, Gurugram) starts at ₹8.50 Cr – ₹14.0 Cr for 4 & 5 BHK Duplex Sky Villas with 4,250 sq.ft carpet area. Key highlights: Private High-Speed Elevator, Panoramic Golf View Balcony, Infinity Rooftop Pool. (RERA: RC/REP/HARERA/GGM/2023/88). Would you like to schedule a private preview or download the floor plans?
Yes, please schedule a private site visit for tomorrow at 11 AM with chauffeur pickup for Grand Horizon.

Excellent! Your VIP Private Site Visit for The Grand Horizon Penthouse & Sky Villas has been confirmed for Tomorrow. Raghav Singhal (Managing Director) will receive you at our Horizon Experience Lounge (Two Horizon Centre, Golf Course Rd). Gate Pass Code: #VIP-8491. Would you require complimentary chauffeur pickup from your residence?
mujhe enquiry karni hai flat ke regarding ?

Namaste! Welcome to Skyline Luxury Estates, Gurugram. I am your autonomous luxury property consultant. I can provide confidential floor plans, exact pricing in ₹ Crores, RERA compliance details, or arrange an accompanied chauffeur site visit. How may I assist your property search today?
Mujhe Golf Course Road par 10 Crore budget me independent villa dekhna hai

The Crestview Signature Golf Villas (Aravalli Hills Foothills, Sector 63, Gurugram) starts at ₹11.50 Cr – ₹18.0 Cr for 5 BHK Independent Villas with 5,800 sq.ft carpet area. Key highlights: Private 400 sq.yd Landscaped Lawn, Basement Home Cinema & Wine Cellar, Heated Indoor Lap Pool. (RERA: RC/REP/HARERA/GGM/2024/405).
